Economy — Make crowns.

Choose a goal. See what unlocks it. Use the opportunities available now to fund the next meaningful improvement.

Current funds and gear are not assumed.

The quick answer

Sell surplus equipment through convenient specialists. Dismantle for a component you need after checking the fee. Price the next chosen upgrade, including access, equip level, service and materials, before buying temporary gear.

Optional weapons you skipped are not a debt to clear. Compare alternatives when they solve a current problem.

Coverage: usable early-Velen paths, regional opportunities, a corrected Grandmaster recipe ledger, and clearly marked research holds. This is not yet an exhaustive whole-game farming catalog.

Fund your next upgrade.

Another buyer is nearbySell there if the offer works for you.

Specialists are a starting point, not a guarantee of the highest price. Don’t buy unwanted stock just to refill a merchant’s wallet.

Keep / dismantle checks & currency exchange →

Is a selling trip worth it?

Combine selling with other business. Travel farther when the haul justifies your time; selling a small load nearby is reasonable.

PATHS / REGIONAL ACCESS

What can you take advantage of now?

The stage menu is a browsing filter, not a claim about your live save. Every opportunity is optional unless needed for your chosen goal.

Showing Early Velen.

Early Velen

Choose an opportunity that suits your level and funding target. These rewards are finite; no repeatable farm is included.

Early Velen — compare opportunities
ActivityLocation / accessPayoffDanger / cost
Crow’s Perch races →Horse Races notice at Crow’s Perch; Radko west of the fortress.First-win equipment rewards: Hans’s +30-capacity saddlebags; Matt’s saddle; Bogdan’s blinders. Equip only if useful.Wager 1–50 crowns per race; losing risks the stake. Equipment prizes are finite.
Shrieker →Crow’s Perch notice; speak to Chet. Suggested level 8.Negotiated contract payment, trophy and monster loot.Cockatrice fight; bring a suitable bomb to flush it out. One contract payout; no rare-drop value promised.
The Merry Widow →Lindenvale notice or gravedigger. Suggested level 10.Contract payment, grave-hag trophy and loot.Grave-hag encounter; allow for repairs and healing. One contract payout; no specific sword promised.

Crow’s Perch races — route & preparation

Access: read Horse Races at Crow’s Perch; speak to Radko at the race start west of the fortress. Select Hans and wager 1–50 crowns. Follow the marked course; finish first.

Other rewards: Stuttering Matt awards a +40-stamina saddle; Black Bogdan awards +20-fear-threshold blinders. The order is flexible. You do not need all three for Hans’s bags. [3]

Strategy recommendation: manage stamina on clear stretches and stay on the marked course. Do not stake money you need for the next service.

Stop: bags obtained or current capacity already adequate. Retry behavior after disqualification has not been independently checked on Xbox 5.01.

Shrieker — route & preparation

Access: read the notice, speak to Chet and negotiate if desired. Talk to Symko; inspect the attack site and follow the blood trail to the cave.

Route: aim a suitable bomb at the high rock shelf. Exit and follow the fleeing monster; the reference says there is no need to hurry. Kill it, loot its trophy, and return to Chet for payment. The notice board does not pay the reward. [7]

Fight recommendation: Quen, short silver attacks from the flank, then disengage. Use Aard when a suitable opening appears. Bring healing; retreat if repeated hits erase your progress.

Stop: reward collected. Rare equipment drops are not included in the funding budget.

The Merry Widow — route & preparation

Route: speak to the gravedigger, investigate the cemetery, follow the scent to the hut, inspect and take the skulls. Place them at the chapel pedestal to trigger the encounter. Kill Mourntart, take the trophy and return to the gravedigger. [8]

Fight recommendation: keep room to evade the tongue strike; use brief silver strings rather than trading hits. Maintain Quen. If you cannot reliably avoid the attack, disengage and improve gear or level before retrying.

Stop: payment collected. Do not budget around a particular rare sword drop.

Velen fistfights — route & preparation

Find the first three opponents at Lindenvale, Blackbough and the Inn at the Crossroads. Defeat them, then challenge the sergeant for the title. [9]

Recommendation: keep wagers affordable; practice spacing and counters before increasing the stake. This circuit is not an unlimited farm. Stop after the regional title or once your immediate funding target is met.

Novigrad

Combine banking, useful sales and optional racing with the business that brought you to the city.

Cash in the currency you carry

Vivaldi Bank · City access · Conversion · Corroborated [4]

Goal: turn florens and orens already owned into spendable crowns.

Novigrad currency exchange — Vivaldi Bank

Visit Vivaldi Bank in Novigrad and choose currency exchange. Combine it with your planned city stop. [4]

Recommendation: compare nearby smith/armorer offers using one representative surplus item. No universal best-buyer ranking is assumed here. Stop once existing currency and worthwhile surplus have been converted.

Upgrade capacity: Vegelbud derby

After Get Junior · 100 crowns per race · Finite rewards · Corroborated [10, 13]

Goal: rugged saddlebags with +70 capacity from the second race. Budget entry for the preceding race too; this is not a single 100-crown purchase.

Vegelbud race — first-win bags

After Get Junior, look for the invitation beside the Hierarch Square announcer. Read it, then speak to the race master at the Vegelbud estate. Win the first race, enter the second and win the bags. The quest is temporarily on hold during Carnal Sins. [10] [13]

Completing the three-race derby opens a Cleaver follow-up; its cash and equipment are optional further rewards. [10]

Recommendation: stop once the desired equipment is obtained. Exact retry/failure rules need separate verification; do not assume every follow-up race has the same rules.

Skellige

Use a defined coastal cluster to fund a purchase. You do not need to clear the ocean.

Loot a coastal cache cluster

Rannvaig–Arinbjorn waters · Sailing / diving · Finite loot · Corroborated [11]

Goal: saleable equipment and other loot. Returns vary; no fixed crown yield is promised.

Coastal underwater caches

The reference describes caches north and northeast from this coastal route, marked by floating barrels with chests below. Sail between nearby markers, dive and loot, then return before weight turns the trip into a chore. [11]

Preparation: crossbow for underwater threats and a route back to shore. Sirens can damage a piloted boat. Historical route lists level-13 enemies; inspect current enemies before committing.

Stop: chosen cluster complete, funding target met, or the next trip is mostly inventory management. Containers are finite.

Exact pin order and a named sale/return circuit remain to be added. This is a supported opportunity, not yet a complete navigation route.

Late base game

Connect the money target to the next gear tier rather than to an arbitrary crown balance.

Fund the next Feline milestone

Whole-run gear goal · Planning · Recommendation

Goal: Enhanced at 23 → Superior at 29 → Mastercrafted at 34. Price only the tier you can use next. [14]

Fund the next useful equipment target

Retain previous Feline pieces required by your next recipes. Check diagram ownership, craftsman capability, missing components and the full fee. Choose an unfinished contract or finite activity you still have available.

Stop: the next useful equipment target and necessary upkeep are funded. Do not treat every remaining icon as required income.

A recipe-by-recipe material ledger and named late-base funding routes remain in research.

Hearts of Stone

One concrete quest route is included here. This chapter still needs a ranked treasure and bandit-loot circuit.

Combine quest progress with loot: Rose on a Red Field

Adela / Garin Estate → Bowdon · Expansion combat · Finite · Corroborated [15]

Goal: quest payment and loot along an investigation you may already want to complete. This is a route option, not a proven highest-profit farm.

Expansion-level combat. Optional early attempt; a complete above-level combat plan is pending. Return later if the initial enemies overwhelm you.
Evil’s Soft First Touches — quest reward

During Evil’s Soft First Touches, speak to Adela after the first conversation with Olgierd. Follow the investigation at Bowdon, trace the killing to the Fallen Knights and their laboratory, then collect the quest reward. [15]

Preparation recommendation: capacity for weapon loot, healing, Quen and a plan to handle groups. The reference lists level-32 ghouls at Bowdon; do not confuse having the DLC installed with being ready for this fight.

Stop: quest payment and sale of surplus. Exact sale circuit and full cost/return comparison are still being researched.

Blood and Wine

Decide what you are funding before repeating combat or committing to expensive materials.

Clear a Hanse base permanently

Mont Crane · Arthach Palace Ruins · Tulasens Caves · Finite completion [16]

Goal: combat loot and a cleared location. This is the alternative to preserving a reported farm.

Preparation, completion & sale

Choose one base rather than a tour of all three. Arrive with capacity for weapons, healing and a retreat path. The official guide recommends level 48+ for assaults; this is advice, not an entry requirement.

Recommendation: prevent reinforcements when survival is the goal, draw manageable groups toward a known exit, and avoid charging deep into a crowd. Loot after combat, then deliberately kill the leader when ready to clear the base. Sell surplus in Beauclair and retain planned recipe inputs. [16]

Stop: selected base cleared, loot sold, or funding goal met. The income depends on drops and sale offers; no fixed total is promised.

Preserving a farm? Read the provisional Mont Crane entry before killing its leader. The finite clearing route and the reported farm are different choices.

Mont Crane: clear it or preserve it?

Toussaint · High-threat Hanse · Farm not verified for Xbox 5.01 [16]

Goal: choose permanent completion or investigate a reported weapon-loot farm. Killing the leader clears the base. Reports of renewable bandits are not yet a verified 5.01 loop.

Verification hold: not a published reliable farm. Full combat/escape strategy, reset procedure and selling circuit are pending.
Hanse base clearance

Documented: this is a Hanse base, and leader defeat changes it to a cleared location. The official guide puts the leader high in the castle structure. It recommends level 48+ for Hanse assaults; that is a recommendation, not an access lock. [16]

Reported: preserving the leader is said to permit repeated bandit spawns. Exact reset timing, travel/portal steps and Xbox reliability remain unverified. No working-loop instructions or yield estimate are claimed here.

Tool distinction: the hidden passage uses the Eye of Nehaleni, not the Magic Lamp. Access to the passage and portal does not establish that a respawn shortcut works. [28] Only killing the leader is treated here as the documented clearing condition; merely drawing his attention is not established as equivalent.

Recommendation: if interested in the farm, avoid killing the leader until you have checked current behavior. Stop when funded, when returns stop justifying time, or when you prefer the permanent completion reward. If already cleared, use other available contracts or finite loot.

Grandmaster Feline: the material path

Toussaint · Level 40 to equip · Lafargue crafts armor and swords · Corroborated recipes [17–22]

Goal: upgrade the pieces you intend to use. For all six, plan 5 infused slyzard hides, 4 enriched dimeritium plates and 5 additional enriched ingots, plus the matching Mastercrafted pieces and smaller components.

Gate: access Toussaint and obtain the diagrams. Earlier tiers are needed for the crafting chain, not to start collecting these diagrams. Mutation research is a separate system.

Retain your current Feline pieces. Each upgrade consumes its immediate predecessor. You do not keep Basic, Enhanced and Superior copies after turning them into the next tier.
Acquire the diagrams & unlock the craft
  1. Visit Lafargue northwest of the Mettina Gate signpost in Beauclair; ask about Cat diagrams.
  2. Collect the chest diagram from the estate east of Arthach Palace Ruins; look behind the portrait.
  3. Collect boots and trousers from the chest on the northern bridge at Arthach Palace Ruins.
  4. Collect gauntlets and both swords from the bag at the end of the nearby cave south of the ruins.
  5. Return with the appropriate Mastercrafted pieces, recipe components and service fees.

[26] Recommendation: treat this as expansion-level combat. Fight manageable groups, avoid being surrounded and return later if the encounters overwhelm your current kit. Do not assume a diagram route requires clearing every nearby Hanse leader.

These are landmark instructions with a linked illustrated reference. Exact embedded map pins and a full above-level combat route are still pending.

Exact six-piece recipes

One of each matching Mastercrafted item is consumed. These are fresh-run recipes, not the Legendary NG+ variants. Confirm the current crafting panel before spending.

Grandmaster piecePrevious item ×1Other materials
Chest armor [17]Mastercrafted Feline armor2 infused slyzard hides · 2 enriched dimeritium plates · 2 monster livers · 2 monster hearts
Gauntlets [18]Mastercrafted Feline gauntlets1 infused slyzard hide · 1 enriched dimeritium ingot · 2 monster bones · 1 powdered monster tissue
Trousers [19]Mastercrafted Feline trousers1 infused slyzard hide · 1 enriched dimeritium plate · 2 monster tongues · 2 monster blood
Boots [20]Mastercrafted Feline boots1 infused slyzard hide · 1 enriched dimeritium plate · 2 monster bones · 4 monster claws
Steel sword [21]Mastercrafted Feline steel sword2 leather scraps · 2 enriched dimeritium ingots · 1 sapphire · 1 monster blood
Silver sword [22]Mastercrafted Feline silver sword2 leather scraps · 2 enriched dimeritium ingots · 1 sapphire · 1 monster tooth

Smaller-component total for all six: 4 leather scraps, 2 sapphires, 2 monster livers, 2 monster hearts, 4 monster bones, 1 powdered monster tissue, 2 monster tongues, 3 monster blood, 4 monster claws and 1 monster tooth. This total excludes everything already consumed to reach Mastercrafted.

Craft the expensive components
MakeInputs per itemReference
Infused slyzard hide1 cured draconid leather + 1 infused crystal[23]
Enriched dimeritium ore1 dimeritium ore + 1 orichalcum ore + 1 acid extract[24]
Enriched dimeritium ingot2 enriched dimeritium ore[25]
Enriched dimeritium plate2 enriched dimeritium ingots[27]

All-six planning equivalent: four plates use eight ingots; add the five direct ingots for 13 enriched ingots in total. If crafting every one from base ore, that means 26 dimeritium ore + 26 orichalcum ore + 26 acid extract. The five hides need five cured draconid leather and five infused crystals.

Arithmetic derived from the recipes above. These are alternatives in the same chain, not an instruction to buy plates, ingots and all their ore inputs together. Subtract materials already owned. Fees apply at each crafting step.

Source it without buying the entire bill

First: inspect owned components and the itemized recipes at Lafargue. He can supply or craft the advanced hides and enriched materials. [26]

Then: check convenient surplus loot for the exact missing inputs using the Dismantle preview. Obtain generic monster materials through suitable loot or previewed dismantling; a named creature’s organ is not automatically the generic ingredient a recipe requests.

Recommendation: retain the relevant ores, acid extract, cured draconid leather and infused crystals as they become useful. Greater mutagens support a different progression goal; they are not ingredients in these six recipes.

Compare all intermediate crafting fees + missing inputs + relevant sale value forgone with the finished component’s offer. Owned inputs are not automatically costless, and crafting is not guaranteed to beat every purchase.

A pin-ordered sourcing circuit and current Xbox price comparison remain unfinished. This is an exact recipe ledger and a decision path, not a tested cheapest-cost route.

Worked target: craft only the chest first

Keep the Mastercrafted chest. The upgrade needs two hides, two plates, two monster livers and two monster hearts. [17]

If none of the advanced materials are owned, two plates expand to four enriched ingots, then eight enriched ore: 8 dimeritium ore + 8 orichalcum ore + 8 acid extract. Two hides require two cured draconid leather and two infused crystals.

Decision: subtract what you own, compare the remaining purchase/crafting bill, then choose an available income or material route to cover that shortfall.

Stop: chest crafted and useful to equip. Continue toward the other pieces only when that goal suits your build and budget.

Gear — Choose the upgrade.

Compare the whole item. Equip what helps now; keep what has a named future use.

On this page

  • Equip or pass?→
  • Temporary gear→
  • School gear & diagrams→

Equip or pass?

Swipe left/right to compare columns.

CheckWeaponArmor
1 · Can I use it?Required level; steel or silver role.Required level; armor weight and chosen skills.
2 · What improves?Damage range, relevant critical bonuses and useful effects.Armor rating and resistance categories relevant to the attacks hurting you.
3 · What do I lose?Useful bonuses, sockets or an equipped set contribution.Useful resistances, weight-class bonuses or an equipped set contribution.
4 · What will it cost?Acquisition, repair, crafting and installed upgrades.The same costs; include the next upgrade you would delay.
5 · DecisionEQUIP if it solves the current problem; KEEP a needed predecessor.EQUIP if the whole comparison helps; do not choose by armor rating alone.
Higher damage, fewer bonuses?
  1. Compare the two weapons at useful condition.
  2. Check bonuses that support the attacks you actually use.
  3. Account for any equipped set bonus you would lose.
  4. Keep the next recipe’s predecessor even if another weapon wins today.

No single arrow or rarity color settles this comparison.

Armor rating or resistances?

Compare both. Resistance categories protect against different attacks; every percentage is not universal protection. Match the comparison to the enemies causing trouble.

Armor weight, defensive choice and skill allocation are separate decisions. A temporary defensive swap can help; check the technique bonus you give up. Exact 5.01 damage formulas remain outside this page.

How do skills and set bonuses affect a swap?
  1. Read the active skill’s armor-weight conditions.
  2. Count the pieces you will actually wear after the swap.
  3. Read the set’s equipped-piece requirements. Stored pieces do not contribute.

Each school profile explains its intended equipment and skill pairing. Build library →

Inspect your stash and claimed reward equipment. Availability depends on your account and installed content; an advertised reward is not proof it is already in your inventory.

Swords & armor — craft or upgrade

StepDo this
1 · Get the diagramCollect or buy the specific recipe. School diagrams & equipment routes →
2 · Open the correct serviceSword → blacksmith. Armor → armorer. Match the diagram’s required craftsman rank.
3 · Fill the inputsCheck the exact component names, quantities, fee and required previous item. Components →
4 · CraftThe inputs and any required predecessor are consumed. The diagram stays learned.
5 · Equip when eligibleYour level requirement is separate from diagram access and service rank.
What does “Mastercrafted” unlock?
TermMeaning
Mastercrafted itemAn equipment tier in some school chains; not a skill unlock.
Master craftsmanA service rank. Unlocking Yoana or Hattori lets them make recipes within that rank.
GrandmasterA later equipment / service tier in Blood and Wine. Lafargue handles Grandmaster crafting.
Upgrade recipeOften consumes the matching previous piece. Read the actual recipe: not every school has the same tier chain.
My recipe is missing or unavailable
  1. Check that the diagram was learned, not just a treasure-map lead.
  2. Open the right craftsman and enable filters for unavailable recipes.
  3. Read the blocked rank, component, previous item or crown requirement.
  4. Go to a higher-rank provider only if rank is the missing requirement.

Who can craft it?

Specialty and rank are separate checks. A Master quest is not required for every Basic craft.

ProviderWhereServiceUnlock
FergusUpper Crow’s PerchJourneyman armorerAvailable before the Master quest.
Oxenfurt blacksmithEast / southeast of the main city islandJourneyman blacksmithUse his ordinary service.
YoanaCrow’s PerchMaster armor; armor ReforgeMaster Armorers →
HattoriDumpling shop, NovigradMaster swords; sword ReforgeOf Swords and Dumplings →
LafargueBeauclair, northwest of Mettina GateGrandmaster armor & swordsToussaint access →
RunewrightUpper Mill, northeast of NovigradBoth specialties; rank follows funded tierHearts of Stone funding →
Unlock Master & Grandmaster services
Yoana — Master Armorers
  1. Ask Fergus at Crow’s Perch about master armor.
  2. Retrieve the tools from Clan Tordarroch Forge on Undvik.
  3. Return; obtain the archgriffin acid gland for Yoana.
  4. Return with it and agree to test the armor; finish the quest.

Refusing the armor test can fail the quest. The encounters are a separate combat-readiness check from your gear’s equip level.

Hattori — Of Swords and Dumplings
  1. Visit Hattori’s dumpling shop in Novigrad.
  2. Meet him at the docks after dusk; finish the negotiation and fight.
  3. Recruit Sukrus through his errand.
  4. Finish the warehouse job and confrontation, then return to Hattori.

Stay through the final confrontation; abandoning it can fail the quest.

Lafargue — Grandmaster crafting
  1. Unlock travel to Toussaint through Blood and Wine.
  2. Visit Lafargue’s Beauclair workshop northwest of Mettina Gate.
  3. Bring the diagram, required predecessor where listed, materials and crowns.

The diagram’s quest and equip level are not the same as the craftsman’s service rank.

Where do recipes come from?

Source labelWhat it meansWhat to do
Fixed locationThe specific diagram has a documented chest or site.Follow the route on the relevant build page.
Quest reward / quest accessThe reward or reachable location depends on that quest.Read the access and cutoff notes before the quest ends.
PurchasedA merchant sells the diagram; stock can depend on merchant or progression.Buy the recipe you need, not merely a similarly named finished item.
Random lootA container can supply a recipe; that exact recipe is not guaranteed there.Treat it as a possible source, not a route promise.
Scavenger mapA lead to diagram locations.Reading a map does not give you the equipment diagrams themselves.

Each specific item needs its own source label. School acquisition routes → · Rune schematics → · Alchemy formulas →

Components — use the exact form

NeedHow to obtain itWhat gets used
Manufactured partBuy it or craft its learned subrecipe.Listed ingredients and each crafting fee.
Generic monster materialLoot it, buy it, or inspect dismantling of a named monster part.The selected organ / part is destroyed if dismantled.
Gem or dustCompare the requested form with merchant stock and dismantling output.Dust and whole gems are different inputs.
Leather, metal or timberCheck finished materials versus their subrecipes.Only the actual listed inputs satisfy the recipe.
Previous equipment tierKeep the matching piece if named by the upgrade recipe.The predecessor becomes the upgraded item.
Price the full component chain
  1. Expand the missing component’s recipe if you know it.
  2. Count missing inputs and intermediate fees.
  3. Compare that route with buying the finished component.
  4. Check dismantling previews for owned loot.
  5. Choose one route; avoid buying both raw materials and the finished part for the same requirement.

Runestones & glyphs

Want to…Do this
Socket a swordUse an owned runestone on an empty sword socket. A diagram is not needed to use a finished stone.
Socket armorUse an owned glyph on an empty armor socket.
Craft a stone / glyphLearn the exact diagram; bring inputs to a qualified craftsman.
Make a stronger tierLearn its diagram and combine the specified lower-tier copies.
Find schematicsCheck smiths, armorers and the Runewright’s shop; the Runewright’s offer expands with funding.
Worked upgrade examples — exact quantities
OutputRecipe inputsRank
Lesser runestone (blank component)1 black pearl dust + 1 infused dustAmateur
Lesser Chernobog runestone1 Lesser runestone + 1 monster essenceAmateur
Chernobog runestone2 Lesser Chernobog runestonesJourneyman
Greater Chernobog runestone2 Chernobog runestonesMaster
Lesser Glyph of Infusion (component)1 silk + 1 powdered pearl + 1 feather + 1 monster bloodAmateur
Lesser Glyph of Quen1 Lesser Glyph of Infusion + 1 ruby dust + 1 infused dustAmateur
Glyph of Quen2 Lesser Glyphs of QuenJourneyman
Greater Glyph of Quen2 Glyphs of QuenMaster

These are named recipes, not a universal conversion rule. Blank runestone components and Glyphs of Infusion have separate recipes. Use the live diagram for other types and fee quotes.

Remove, recover or replace?
OperationEquipmentInstalled upgrade
Remove upgradesKept.Ordinary installed stones / glyphs are destroyed.
Dismantle equipmentDestroyed for previewed components.Check the recovery preview before confirming.
Apply a runeword / glyphwordKept; the word uses all three sockets.Existing socketed stones / glyphs are lost.
Replace a wordKept; one word per item.Previous word is overwritten; its ingredients are not refunded.
Craft the next gear tierListed predecessor is consumed.Exact 5.01 transfer behavior remains a live-test hold.

Enchanting — Hearts of Stone

Where: the Ofieri Runewright at Upper Mill, northeast of Novigrad. Funding unlocks the workshop; adding sockets and supplying the enchantment ingredients are separate costs.

Service tierPay at this stageTotal fundingAccess
15,000 crowns5,000 crownsComplete the jade delivery; Tier 1 words.
210,000 more15,000 crownsTier 2 words.
315,000 more30,000 crownsTier 3 words.
Unlock the workshop — step by step
  1. Meet the Runewright at Upper Mill; start Enchanting: Start-up Costs.
  2. Pay the initial 5,000 crowns.
  3. Continue Enchanting: Quality Has Its Price; obtain the pickaxe and required jade from the marked search sites.
  4. Deliver the jade to enable the service.
  5. Fund higher tiers only as needed for the word you want.
Apply an enchantment — requirements & cost
StepCheck
1 · Choose the wordRuneword → sword. Glyphword → chest armor. The word’s level is a required service tier, not a rank to level up.
2 · Prepare three socketsUse an eligible item with three sockets; the Runewright can add missing sockets for a quoted fee.
3 · Bring the exact stonesEach catalog row lists the consumed recipe. Lesser, ordinary and Greater are different inputs.
4 · Read the confirmationCheck the live charge, socket cost and ingredients. Existing installed upgrades are lost when the word is applied.
5 · Apply one wordThe word occupies the item’s three sockets. It is not three separate enchantments.

Total budget: any remaining workshop funding + missing-socket fees + stones you must buy / craft + any charge shown by the live enchantment confirmation. Database base prices are not treated as your merchant quote.

Sword enchantments — all 9 runewords

Each ingredient is one runestone unless a quantity is shown. No prefix means ordinary quality.

WordTierEffectIngredients consumed

Prolongation3Each unblocked hit adds one second to potion duration.Greater Morana + Greater Perun + Greater Svarog
Replenishment3After a Sign, spends an Adrenaline Point to empower the next sword attack with that Sign.Greater Triglav + Greater Morana + Greater Dazhbog

Each ingredient is one Glyph of the named type. No prefix = ordinary; Lesser / Greater applies to each listed glyph.

WordTierEffectIngredients consumed

Potions

Use Geralt’s Alchemy menu for the first craft and each upgrade. Refill ordinary potion doses by meditating with suitable strong alcohol. Crafting, upgrades & refills →

Potion catalog — effect, use & upgrades
PotionWhat it doesWhen it helpsUpgrade payoff
Black Blood →Punishes vampires and necrophages that wound you.Fights against those categories.Basic → Enhanced → Superior. Superior adds nearby bleeding and hit-triggered knockback.
Blizzard →Slows time when danger triggers it.Dangerous exchanges; check the live trigger.Basic → Enhanced → Superior. Superior adds Stamina-free actions with three Adrenaline Points.
Cat →Improves sight in darkness.Dark caves and interiors.Basic → Enhanced → Superior. Superior adds hypnosis immunity; check tier’s critical bonus.
Drowner pheromones →Makes drowners leave Geralt alone.Drowner encounters; still watch other enemies.Single tier.
Full Moon →Raises maximum Vitality.A temporary health buffer.Basic → Enhanced → Superior. Superior also heals based on current Toxicity.
Golden Oriole →Counters poison and its existing effects.Poisonous enemies or hazards.Basic → Enhanced → Superior. Superior makes poison heal.
Killer Whale →Improves underwater vision and breath supply.Longer underwater treasure searches.Single tier.
Maribor Forest →Improves Adrenaline generation.Builds that spend or maintain Adrenaline.Basic → Enhanced → Superior. Superior grants an Adrenaline Point when consumed.
Petri's Philter →Boosts Sign intensity.Casting-focused encounters.Basic → Enhanced → Superior. Superior adds the stated special-effect benefit; enemy immunity still matters.
Swallow →Regenerates Vitality over time.Sustained recovery rather than an instant heal.Basic → Enhanced → Superior. Superior regeneration is not interrupted by taking damage.
Tawny Owl →Improves Stamina recovery.More frequent casting or Stamina-dependent attacks.Basic → Enhanced → Superior. Superior lasts through the night.
Thunderbolt →Raises attack power.Sword damage support.Basic → Enhanced → Superior. Superior adds storm-dependent critical chance.
White Honey →Clears Toxicity and ends active potion effects.Resetting an alchemy setup; buffs are sacrificed.Basic → Enhanced → Superior. Higher tiers provide more doses.
White Raffard's Decoction →Restores Vitality immediately.Emergency healing; classified as a potion.Basic → Enhanced → Superior. Superior fully heals and adds brief damage immunity.
Reinald's Philter →Boosts Signs and Stamina recovery.Quest-linked tool, not an ordinary shopping target.Single quest-linked recipe; special availability.

Oils

Craft the oil once, then apply it to the correct sword or use the automatic-oil option. The bottle is reusable; its coating has charges. Reapply when needed rather than recrafting or buying a new bottle. Check the live tier tooltip for bonus and charges.

Bombs

Craft once, equip in a bomb slot, select it on the quick-access wheel and use the displayed throw / aim controls. Meditate with suitable strong alcohol to refill. Each upgrade has its own formula and uses the previous version.

Bomb catalog — effect, use & upgrades
BombWhat it doesWhen to use itUpgrade path
Dancing Star →Fire explosion and burning.Burn-vulnerable targets; destroys nests.Basic → Enhanced → Superior; check each tier’s extra effect and stock.
Devil's Puffball →Leaves a poison cloud.Poison-susceptible enemies.Basic → Enhanced → Superior; check each tier’s extra effect and stock.
Dimeritium bomb →Suppresses magic in its cloud.Magical enemy abilities; avoid relying on your own Signs inside the cloud.Basic → Enhanced → Superior; check each tier’s extra effect and stock.
Dragon's Dream →Leaves gas that needs ignition.Follow with a fire source.Basic → Enhanced → Superior; check each tier’s extra effect and stock.
Grapeshot →Shrapnel blast with some fire damage.Direct blast damage; destroys nests.Basic → Enhanced → Superior; check each tier’s extra effect and stock.
Moon Dust →Prevents supported transformations and regeneration.Specters or regenerating enemies named by Bestiary.Basic → Enhanced → Superior; check each tier’s extra effect and stock.
Northern Wind →Freezes susceptible enemies.Create an attack opening; some enemies resist it.Basic → Enhanced → Superior; check each tier’s extra effect and stock.
Samum →Blinds enemies in the blast.Interrupt a group; destroys nests.Basic → Enhanced → Superior; check each tier’s extra effect and stock.

Decoctions

Long-lasting effects also reserve Toxicity while active. Ordinary mutagen decoctions have one recipe tier and refill through meditation with suitable alcohol; ingredients are for the first brew. Check capacity before drinking →

Other common bottlenecks
NeedLook hereExact form matters
Cherry / Mandrake cordial; Redanian herbalInspect innkeepers’ drink stock and other merchants.Reserve the specific drinks for White Gull.
HerbsGather plants or buy from herbalists.Water plants and cave plants have different habitats.
Monster partsLoot the right monster; inspect dismantling if the recipe requests a generic material.A named organ is not interchangeable with a similarly named generic component.
Powders, fats and pasteInspect alchemist / herbalist ingredient stock and owned loot.The bomb, oil or potion recipe names the exact base; do not substitute a different powder.

Component and dismantling help →

First craft, upgrades & replenishment

ActionWhat you needWhat happens
First brewLearned formula + exact ingredients.Geralt crafts it in Alchemy; no smith or workbench required.
UpgradeThe new formula, previous version and new ingredients.Basic → Enhanced → Superior where that family has three tiers.
Refill potions / bombs / ordinary decoctionsMeditation with suitable strong alcohol in inventory.Used doses restock; do not gather the first-craft herbs and organs again.
Reapply an oilThe already-crafted bottle and a compatible sword.Restores the coating without crafting another bottle.
Make White Gull or substancesIngredients for every copy.These are consumed materials, not refillable dose stocks.

Keep Alcohest or Dwarven spirit available for refills. Do not rely on meditation to manufacture White Gull. Find supplies →

Toxicity — capacity is not the safe threshold

CheckAction
1 · Read your current statsUse your live maximum and overdose marker; gear and active skills can change them.
2 · Check the next doseRead its Toxicity cost before stacking it with current potions or decoctions.
3 · Distinguish two limitsBeing able to drink within capacity does not guarantee you are below the threshold that causes health loss.
4 · Account for durationPotion Toxicity falls over time; a decoction’s reservation lasts with its effect.
5 · Reset deliberatelyWhite Honey clears Toxicity and cancels potion effects. Meditation can reset your setup and refill doses.
Version caution & build links

Do not import an old 75% threshold or four-decoction setup as a universal rule. Exact 5.01 threshold math and skill exceptions remain a live-verification hold. School and hybrid allocations →

YolarGedyneith’s druid grove, Skellige.Another listed seller for many advanced recipes.
Unlock Gremist’s shop
  1. Speak to Gremist near Gedyneith and accept Practicum in Advanced Alchemy.
  2. Complete the pimpernel, distillery and Fritjof objectives.
  3. Return and finish the waiting / conversation sequence.
  4. Speak again to browse his stock; purchasing is still required for unknown formulas.

There is substantive combat on the route. Maps & routes →

Combat troubleshooting — what is going wrong?
ProblemFirst adjustmentNext check / detail
Getting surroundedMove toward the group’s edge; keep an escape route.Keep the next attacker in view. Humans & mixed groups →
Hit during a comboShorten the string; punish recovery, then reset.Watch the end of the whole attack sequence. Attack & defense →
Enemy blocks or countersCreate an opening before committing more attacks.Try a flank or a susceptible interruption. Choose a Sign →
Barely dealing damageCheck enemy level, sword drawn, condition and protective state.Match the category and oil; check active skills. Oil & sword matrix →
Cannot cast when neededLeave resources and space for the next cast.Shorten sustained Whirl or repeated casts. Stamina & Adrenaline →

Attack & defense

Attack loop — position, opening, punish, reset
StepDo thisStop / reassess when
1 · PositionSee the threats and leave an escape lane.A second attacker moves onto your flank.
2 · Draw an attackWatch the committed swing, then move off its line.The sequence continues or covers the ground around you.
3 · Punish recoveryStart with one or two fast attacks; use the opening you actually have.The enemy recovers, a new windup begins or your escape closes.
4 · ResetReposition and replace protection during space you create.Avoid a fixed hit count; repeat a clean exchange.
Fast attacks, strong attacks & Whirl
AttackBest openingCost / drawbackWhen to stop
Fast attacksThe opening is brief; you can land a short string safely.Short commitment; extending the string exposes you.The enemy recovers or another attacker approaches.
Strong attacksA longer recovery gives you time for the slower swing.Slower commitment gives enemies more time to interrupt.You cannot finish the swing safely.
WhirlA controlled crowd or exposed target gives you a sustained opening.Sustained use drains Stamina, then Adrenaline. Emptying both can leave your next Sign unavailable and Adrenaline-dependent abilities unfunded.Before you empty your reserves, or immediately when the opening closes.

End Whirl while you still have options. Don’t wait for empty meters to stop you.

Leave resources for your next action—especially a defensive Sign or an Adrenaline-dependent ability.

Skill choices and how to use them → Builds

Dodge, roll, guard, counter & Quen
DefenseUse it when…Drawback / limit
DodgeYou can evade a swing and stay close for a follow-up.Direction matters; don’t dodge into another attacker.
RollYou need distance from a broad attack, hazard or surrounding group.Takes you out of striking range.
GuardYou recognize an ordinary, blockable weapon attack.Heavy blows can break through; unreliable as a universal monster defense.
CounterYou recognize a counterable strike and can time the response.Not every attack can be countered. Switch to evasion when uncertain.
QuenYou want protection while learning timing or taking an opening.Costs Stamina. Once broken, create space to recast instead of finishing an unsafe combo.

Choose by the incoming attack. Armor weight doesn’t dictate your defensive tool.

Signs

Five Signs — choose the result you need
SignUse it to…Main limitation
Quen →Protect an exchange and give yourself a margin for error.Costs Stamina; a broken shield means reassess. Basic Quen does not heal.
Yrden →Control an area and make affected specters vulnerable.Position matters—keep the target in the useful area.
Aard →Interrupt, knock down or ground a susceptible target.Range and resistance matter; not every enemy reacts.
Axii →Disorient a susceptible opponent to create space or an opening.Not universal control. Dialogue use depends on Delusion and the scene.
Igni →Exploit fire susceptibility or disrupt with Burning.Some enemies resist it; igniting nearby gas can endanger you.

All five basic Signs are available from the start. Select a Sign above for its specific uses. Skill purchases and point orders stay on Builds.

Casting — basic or alternate?
VersionWhat to doWhat you need
Basic SignSelect the Sign and briefly press its cast input.Available from the start; sufficient Stamina.
Alternate modeHold the appropriate cast input.The alternate skill’s prerequisites and activation requirements met; sufficient Stamina.
Quick Sign CastingUse the displayed Sign-specific input; hold it for the alternate.Enable Quick Sign Casting in Gameplay settings.

Wrong version coming out? Check your controller prompts, whether you’re pressing or holding, and whether the alternate is active.

Which alternate changes which Sign?
SignAlternateWhat changes
AardAard SweepBlast around Geralt.
IgniFirestreamHeld stream of fire.
YrdenMagic TrapDeployable discharge that damages and slows.
QuenActive ShieldHeld protection; absorbed damage restores Vitality.
AxiiPuppetmasterInfluenced target temporarily fights for you.

Cast inputs depend on your selected controller layout. Verify the active binding on device; see controller notes under Status & sources.

Check the live node’s prerequisite, rank, activation and resource requirements. Purchase alone does not establish that the alternate is active.

Quen — basic shield, Exploding Shield or Active Shield?
VersionPayoffCost / drawbackHow to use it
Basic QuenProtective shield while you move and attack.Costs Stamina; does not heal.Cast before committing; create space to replace it after it breaks.
Exploding ShieldAdds a shield-break effect that can create breathing room.Skill investment and activation requirements; not every enemy is displaced.Treat the break as a chance to reposition.
Active ShieldHeld protection; absorbed damage restores Vitality.Skill investment, activation requirements and Stamina management; you stop attacking while holding it.Use a controlled healing window, then release and reposition.

Basic Quen and Active Shield are different actions. A normal shield cast does not gain Active Shield’s healing simply because you purchased the skill. Exact ranks and purchase order live on Builds.

Basic Quen — four steps
  1. Cast with room to finish the action.
  2. Take a normal opening.
  3. Shorten or leave the exchange when the shield breaks.
  4. Create space before recasting.
Exploding Shield — what to check
  • Meet the skill’s activation requirements.
  • Use the break as a possible exit; do not assume bosses are displaced.
  • Exact reflection values and interaction with alternates remain holds.
Active Shield — unlock & healing steps

The current database connects Exploding Shield to Active Shield. Purchasing the prerequisite and activating its own effect are separate checks.

  1. Activate Active Shield and find an isolated, readable attacker.
  2. Hold the alternate with sufficient resources.
  3. Check whether the hit is absorbed and Vitality returns.
  4. Release and reposition before the hold becomes unsafe.

Rank-dependent drain and exact Xbox behavior still need field confirmation. Database reference →

Yrden — placement, specters & upgrades
UsePayoffCost / limitationPractical action
Basic YrdenSlows affected enemies; makes affected specters vulnerable.Costs Stamina and depends on positioning.Cast where you have room to fight; draw the target into it.
Against spectersCreates a window for effective silver-sword attacks.Chasing outside the trap can waste the opening.Use short strings; reposition or replace the trap when needed.
Magic Trap alternateAdds a damaging, slowing discharge.Requires skill investment and activation; placement still matters.Deploy where it can influence the fight without trapping your movement.

Place the trap where you want the fight to happen.

Detailed specter tactics → Enemy preparation · Upgrade ranks and purchase order → Builds

When would Magic Trap or other upgrades help?
Observed problem / choiceOptional investmentCheck before buying
Want a damaging, slowing dischargeMagic Trap alternate.Activation requirements and whether the target stays in useful range.
Want damage on affected targetsSupercharged Glyphs.Current tooltip and the actual encounter.
Want longer / broader trap utilitySustained Glyphs.Exact current scope, trap count and basic/alternate interactions remain holds.

Use your build page for a complete allocation path.

Aard, Axii & Igni — specific uses
Aard — create an opening
UsePayoffCost / limitationPractical action
Interrupt or knock downCan stop a susceptible enemy and create an attack window.Costs Stamina; resistance and enemy state matter.Check its reaction before committing to the follow-up.
Ground a flying enemyCan bring a susceptible flyer into sword range.Range and timing matter; not every flying phase is interruptible.Cast within reach, then punish the landing.
Break an obstacleOpens Aard-breakable walls, doors or debris.Illusions and switch-operated walls require different interactions.Inspect the obstacle rather than repeatedly blasting it.
Aard Sweep alternateBlasts around Geralt instead of only forward.Requires skill investment and activation.Use when threats surround you; confirm which enemies actually react.

Aard creates an opportunity—check that it worked before rushing in.

Upgrade ranks and purchase order → Builds

Axii — combat control & dialogue
VersionPayoffCost / limitationPractical action
Basic AxiiDisorients a susceptible opponent, creating space or an opening.Costs Stamina; some targets resist it.Reposition or exploit the opening once you see it work.
DelusionEnables eligible Axii dialogue choices.Requires the displayed rank and activation before the conversation. Outcomes can still have consequences.Optional, but useful for players who want more dialogue approaches.
Puppetmaster alternateMakes an affected enemy temporarily fight for you.Requires skill investment and activation; not universal control.Turn a susceptible opponent against the group, then use the opening.

Delusion and Puppetmaster do different jobs. One supports dialogue; the other changes combat behavior.

Ranks and purchase order → Builds

Igni — fire, Burning & hazards
UsePayoffCost / limitationPractical action
Basic IgniFire damage and possible Burning against susceptible enemies.Costs Stamina; some targets resist fire or do not ignite.Use the reaction to attack or reposition—don’t assume Burning will trigger.
Environmental hazardsIgnites flammable gas and other combustible hazards.The explosion can endanger Geralt too.Create safe distance before igniting the area.
Firestream alternateA held stream of fire.Requires skill investment and activation; sustained casting commits resources and leaves you exposed.Use a controlled opening; release before enemies close in or resources run low.

Cast for a useful result, then reassess. Repeated fire casts against a resistant target can waste your next defensive Sign.

Category traps — wings and appearances can mislead
EnemyCorrect category / oilAvoid
WerewolfCursed Ones / Cursed Oil.Treating it as an ordinary Beast.

Enemy counters — common situations
Necrophages — packs, death explosions & foglets
SituationResponsePreparation
Drowners / ghoulsWork at the edge; punish isolated attacks.Necrophage Oil / silver; Quen or useful fire.
Rotfiend / devourer deathBreak away as the death explosion starts.Do not finish inside the blast radius.
Foglet / illusionsWatch moving mist; punish the real attack recovery.Moon Dust can disrupt invisibility.
Grave / water hagGive the individual attacks room; avoid long trades.Check the named target’s live entry.
Specters — make the target hittable
StepDo thisReset when
1 · PrepareSilver + Specter Oil; place Yrden where you can maneuver.Placement traps you against terrain.
2 · Draw it inLet the specter enter the materializing area.It leaves the useful area.
3 · PunishUse short attacks during the material window.It phases out or begins another attack.
4 · Copies / exceptionsClear noonwraith/nightwraith copies promptly.The encounter has a separate protection mechanic.

Moon Dust is another anti-transformation tool. Bomb lookup → · Yrden upgrades →

Beasts — wolves, dogs & bears
TargetResponseSword / oil
Wolf / dog packKeep the pack in view; punish isolated lunges instead of chasing through it.Steel / Beast Oil.
BearWait through the whole swing; attack the recovery.Steel / Beast Oil.
Insectoids — poison & colony space
ProblemResponsePreparation
PoisonUse a prepared poison counter if needed.Golden Oriole; Insectoid Oil / silver.
Nest / crowded colonyChoose open fighting space; handle workers and warriors deliberately.Do not get surrounded inside the nest approach.
Ogroids — nekkers & trolls
TargetResponsePreparation
NekkersControl the pack edge and watch fresh pressure from holes.Ogroid Oil / silver.
TrollLearn throws and overhead recoveries before committing.Some trolls can be reasoned with; combat is not always required.
Draconids — flight, landings & venom
SituationResponsePreparation
Flying / divingStay mobile; use a susceptible grounding opportunity.Draconid Oil / silver; Aard, crossbow or useful listed bomb.
LandingPunish recovery without overrunning the safe window.Check the specific contract entry.
VenomBring a poison answer when relevant.Tools vary by species.
Elementa — charge, slam & control resistance
ThreatResponsePreparation
Charge / ground slamLeave its line or area; punish the completed recovery.Elementa Oil / silver.
Control resistanceDo not assume human-style Aard stagger works.Dimeritium is useful for some targets; check the entry.
Several attacks in one sequenceObserve the whole sequence before closing.One dodge does not establish a safe opening.
Cursed Ones — werewolves & berserkers
SituationResponsePreparation
Werewolf / ulfhedinn regenerationInterrupt regeneration, then resume short exchanges.Cursed Oil on silver. Moon Dust for regeneration control. Igni or Devil’s Puffball for burning/poison pressure.
Fast lunges and claw sequencesEvade rather than counter; keep room to dodge; punish recovery.Open ground; Yrden to slow entry; Quen as insurance.
If wolves joinClear them while keeping the werewolf in view.Beast Oil useful only on the wolves.
Berserker (human form → bear form)Fight as human while it is human; switch tools the moment it transforms.Steel + Hanged Man’s Venom while human; silver + Cursed Oil after transformation.
Hybrids — flight & grounding
SituationResponsePreparation
Circling or divingMove sideways out of the dive; use a clear grounding opportunity.Hybrid Oil on silver; Aard or crossbow where effective.
Landed or knocked downClose for a short attack string; dodge the next attack and reset.Leave room to evade wings, claws, or other follow-up attacks.
Relicts — fiends & leshens
SituationResponsePreparation
Fiend’s third eye begins glowingInterrupt hypnosis before it takes hold.Samum; Relict Oil on silver.
Fiend charges or swipesSidestep the charge; dodge swipes and punish recovery.Keep room to evade; Quen for insurance.
Leshen roots or clawsRoll clear of advancing roots; dodge claws, then close.Relict Oil on silver; Igni for burning pressure.
Leshen dissolves into smokeStop swinging; find its new position and close as it reforms.Keep Igni ready.
Vampires — visibility, claws & blood drain

Silver + Vampire Oil throughout.

SituationResponsePreparation
Katakan turns invisibleTrack its shadow; reveal it before committing to attacks.Moon Dust or Yrden; Igni when there’s an opening.
Ekimmara claw rushDodge the sequence; punish recovery rather than trying to parry.Quen; Igni for burning pressure.
Bruxa / alp disappearsKeep moving and track the distortion; attack when you can locate it.Moon Dust improves tracking; Yrden helps control movement.
Bruxa prepares a screamRoll clear of the shockwave; close after it passes.Keep room to escape instead of relying on guard.
Bruxa / alp attempts a blood-draining leapDodge the leap. Black Blood is backup if caught, not a reason to take the hit.Drink Black Blood beforehand if available and toxicity permits.
Humans & mixed groups — guards, shields, heavy weapons

Steel + Hanged Man’s Venom applies to humans/nonhumans; switch sword and oil for any monsters present. Category / oil / sword lookup →

SituationResponsePreparation
Shield blocks your attacksCreate an opening rather than repeatedly striking the shield.Axii or a flank; Hanged Man’s Venom on steel.
Heavy weapon winds upEvade, then punish recovery.Quen as backup; don’t trade hits.
Archer pressures you during meleeBreak the firing line or close when safe.Use cover; Aard or Igni only when within range.
Group surrounds youMove toward the edge; keep attackers in view.Hanged Man’s Venom on steel; Quen.

Coverage & source notes

This is a working collection, not a complete atlas of every interior. Some maps cover an outdoor approach or several quest locations rather than every room. Two Freya’s Garden entries are alternate quest annotations of the same place.

Maps are GameBanshee originals, credited beside each image. Their numbers match the linked source legend. Devil’s Pit uses VULKK’s illustrated walkthrough. These are historical navigation references, not independently tested Xbox 5.01 layouts, enemy levels or reward tables.

Map images require internet access. They load from the publisher when you open a dropdown. Open full-size for browser zoom. If an image does not display, use the source guide link. Guide text and the directory remain available in the downloaded console.

What still needs a floor plan?

Devil’s Pit currently has a screenshot route only. Dedicated interior plans for additional Witcher-gear caves, Grandmaster diagram interiors and small unmarked caves remain a research gap. A regional marker is not being presented as a room-by-room dungeon map.

No claim of complete floor-by-floor coverage, independent Xbox testing or reliable offline image caching is made.

Arrival & services

Operation 01 STOP gate. Complete when arrival, connection, services, and steel check are done and the Baron audience has opened Family Matters. Horse races and Baron Gwent are optional recommendations, not requirements. Safe to begin Operation 02 (Midcopse / Keira) once those four checklist items are satisfied.

Start with the main lead. Crow’s Perch and Midcopse become your service anchors.

Required progression · Vizima → Hanged Man’s Tree

Goal / requirement: Finish Imperial Audience and recover your equipment.

Payoff: Opens the Velen main lead

Cutoff / caution: None

Walkthrough & help — quest / encounter spoilers

Arrival route. Leave White Orchard after the Imperial Audience. Follow the road into Velen to the Inn at the Crossroads, then to Heatherton, then to Crow’s Perch.

If you are already in Velen with the Nilfgaardian Connection path complete, mark this item manually — the guide does not read save-game progress.

STOP gate (partial): You are on the correct path once the Crossroads inn is reachable. Full Operation 01 completion also requires the three items below.

Required progression · Crossroads inn → Heatherton · suggested 5

Goal / requirement: Velen access; follow the Hendrik lead at the Crossroads inn.

Payoff: Bloody Baron + Hunting a Witch leads

Cutoff / caution: Peaceful inn resolution makes castle entry easier

Walkthrough & help — quest / encounter spoilers

Nilfgaardian Connection → Hendrik.

  1. At the Inn at the Crossroads, speak with the innkeeper. The Baron’s men interrupt.
  2. Inn encounter (determines entry conditions at Crow’s Perch):
    • Peaceful (“I’m a witcher” or buy them a drink) → main gate access later.
    • Hostile (fight / kill them) → main gate refused; alternate entrance required.
  3. Travel to Heatherton. Search Hendrik’s body for the cellar key (in his boots). Open the trapdoor under the rug. Use the candlestick trigger in the cellar to reveal his notes.
  4. Two leads open: Bloody Baron (Crow’s Perch) and Hunting a Witch (Midcopse). Both remain available; order is player choice.

Alternate Crow’s Perch entrance (only if the main gate is refused): In the lower village, speak to the old man on a pile of wood. He can sell directions for 15 crowns (optional). Go to the northwestern shrine, swim the submerged cave across the moat, clear the Water Hag, climb the ledges, and exit via the well inside the fortress.

Verified: The 15-crown payment is for the villager’s directions on the alternate route, not a main-gate bribe. Fighting the men does not lock the Baron quest.

Recommended · Crow’s Perch · map pin 4

Goal / requirement: Reach Crow’s Perch and inspect the actual service panels.

Payoff: Merchant / repair base; Shrieker contract

Cutoff / caution: Master Armorers is a later service unlock, not an opening requirement

Walkthrough & help — quest / encounter spoilers

Crow’s Perch services. Establish the hub before leaving for Midcopse.

  • Lower village: general merchant and early Gwent.
  • Upper courtyard forge: Fergus Graem (journeyman armorer — repair, dismantle, journeyman crafts). Yoana works the same forge; Master Armorers unlocks later.
  • Quartermaster (awning opposite the forge): materials, diagrams, Nilfgaardian armor set, saddlebags for sale.
  • Notice board: horse races, contracts.

Horse races (optional, recommended for capacity). Notice board or speak to Radko west of the fortress. Three opponents; order does not matter. Each first-win prize is unique and finite. Wager 1–50 crowns (win returns double the stake). Each race also awards 25 XP. Fixed first-win bonuses are separate from the wager return:

OpponentEquipmentStatFixed crowns
Stuttering MatkoRacing Saddle+40 stamina+20
Iron-Arse HansSaddlebags+30 carrying capacity+30
Black BogdanHorse Blinders+20 fear tolerance+40

Losing risks only the stake; rematches are available. Equipment prizes are first-win only.

Baron Gwent (optional). After the initial Family Matters room investigation, the Baron becomes available as a Gwent opponent. His reward is the Sigismund Dijkstra card (Northern Realms Spy). If you advance his storyline far enough that he leaves or becomes unavailable, recover the card from the Baron’s notes in his office; this also triggers Gwent: Velen Players.

Link out as needed: Selling decisions · Keep / dismantle.

Recommended · Your current sword / available loot

Goal / requirement: Compare only items you can currently equip and afford to maintain.

Payoff: Affordable human / beast damage

Cutoff / caution: No need to return just to finish the Viper pair

Walkthrough & help — quest / encounter spoilers

Steel weapon check. Confirm you have a usable steel sword. Missing Viper steel is not a build failure and is not a reason to delay Velen.

Practical early upgrades for a Feline duelist this operation:

  • Capacity first (Hans saddlebags or purchase from the Quartermaster).
  • Repair kits and basic oils from the forge / merchants.
  • Nilfgaardian armor pieces from the Quartermaster only if you have a clear gap.

Defer the full Feline diagram hunt and master-level crafting. Keep the current Feline tier once you start its upgrade chain.

Use the full-item comparison when you are ready to plan the next steel upgrade.

Keira · exploration unlocks

Operation 02 STOP gate (recommended). Hunting a Witch complete · Wandering in the Dark complete with Eye of Nehaleni · Magic Lamp completed · Yrden Place of Power drawn · Keira invitation received. If Magic Lamp failed, document that outcome; do not auto-complete v_lamp or v_power. Optional gargoyle / side chests are not STOP blockers. Safe to begin Operation 03 once the recommended conditions are met.

Hunting a Witch → Wandering in the Dark → Magic Lamp → return to Keira for the lamp handoff.

Build priority · Midcopse → Keira’s hut · suggested 5

Goal / requirement: Follow the Hunting a Witch lead to Midcopse.

Payoff: Keira route

Cutoff / caution: After The Nilfgaardian Connection

Walkthrough & help — quest / encounter spoilers

Hunting a Witch. From Crow’s Perch (or any Velen signpost) travel to Midcopse. Ask villagers about the local witch or locate Keira’s hut directly.

  1. Inspect the hut interior; the skull and other clues reveal a portal.
  2. Step through and meet Keira Metz.
  3. Complete the conversation about Ciri and the masked elf. Wandering in the Dark opens.
  4. Travel with her immediately or meet her later at the elven ruins (northwest of Byways / near Lake Wyndamer).

Loot the chest above the ruin entrance before entering. Suggested readiness ~6; bring repair kits, potions, oils, and bombs. Save outside the entrance.

Build priority · Elven ruins south of Keira · suggested 6

Goal / requirement: Meet Keira and agree to explore the ruins.

Payoff: Eye of Nehaleni for illusion removal, optional side loot including Maugrim, and continuation of Keira’s quest line.

Cutoff / caution: Accept Magic Lamp before leaving the ruins

Walkthrough & help — quest / encounter spoilers

Wandering in the Dark — mandatory route.

  1. Enter with Keira. Her portal malfunctions and separates you.
  2. You land among drowners; clear them and find Keira (Witcher Sense / her calls).
  3. Destroy the rat nests with Igni or bombs.
  4. Rejoin Keira; follow swallow symbols.
  5. Kelpie projection: investigate the horse symbols, including the submerged symbol in the central pool.
  6. Activate the next portal using the swallow symbol.
  7. Defeat the golem (Elementa oil is appropriate here).
  8. White Frost: stay inside Keira’s protective shield; defend her from Wild Hunt hounds; allow her to close all three rifts. Avoid unnecessary trips into the freezing area.
  9. Nithral (Wild Hunt warrior — see phases below).
  10. Search the laboratory; receive the Eye of Nehaleni.

Nithral — phase guide (do not use Elementa oil on him):

  • Phase A — Sword: Quen active; short attack strings; dodge heavy swings; Thunderbolt when appropriate.
  • Phase B — Shield & regeneration: He becomes protected and summons hounds. Do not attack his shield. Kill the hounds promptly to end the phase and limit healing.
  • Phase C — Re-engage: Reapply Quen; resume controlled sword work; repeat until defeated.

Loot Nithral’s remains before leaving the chamber.

Optional only (not required for progression):

  • Gargoyle side route — extra combat and loot; skip if under-prepared. Elementa oil OK here.
  • Maugrim silver sword — behind an illusion after the Eye of Nehaleni; foglet ambush.

Nearby loot route — individual stops and walkthroughs.

Build priority · Same ruins · suggested 6

Goal / requirement: Agree to Keira’s request at the end of the ruins route.

Payoff: Quest complete; Keira retrieves the lamp

Cutoff: Accept Keira’s request while still in the ruins. Refusing skips this quest; leaving the ruins after accepting fails it. Finish the search and nearby exploration before leaving.

Walkthrough & help — quest / encounter spoilers

Magic Lamp. When Keira asks for help after the laboratory, accept immediately (recommended).

  • Leaving the ruins with Magic Lamp unfinished can fail the quest.
  • An initial refusal may still be recoverable before departure by following Keira into the puzzle chamber — recovery path only, not the recommended route.

Brazier solution: number the four braziers left → right while facing the sealed door. Light 3 → 2 → 4 → 1. Incorrect order summons wraiths.

Keira retrieves the lamp. Do not exit yet — continue to the Place of Power step.

Nearby loot route — individual stops and walkthroughs.

Build priority · Inside the Keira ruins · map pin 7

Goal / requirement: Reach the optional passage in the ruins / lamp area.

Payoff: 1 permanent ability point

Cutoff / caution: Interior location; map pin marks its position, not a separate surface entrance

Walkthrough & help — quest / encounter spoilers

Yrden Place of Power. After Keira has the lamp:

  1. Do not exit the ruins immediately.
  2. Climb the stone ledges in the lamp chamber.
  3. Locate and draw from the Yrden Place of Power — permanent Ability Point.

Nearby golem combat and treasure are optional. Treat the skill point as a collect-now priority, not a later-return target.

If Magic Lamp was failed, this Place of Power may be inaccessible; do not mark this objective complete by default in that case.

Nearby loot route — individual stops and walkthroughs.

Build priority · Return to Keira’s hut

Goal / requirement: Return to the hut after the ruins; accept the island job.

Payoff: Usable Magic Lamp + A Towerful of Mice

Cutoff / caution: Buy wanted recipes / Clearance before ending her chain

Walkthrough & help — quest / encounter spoilers

Keira invitation. After resolving the ruins (and ideally Magic Lamp + Place of Power), confirm Keira’s follow-up invitation. She directs you toward further work (Fyke Isle / lamp use) that begins Operation 03.

Accepting the invitation establishes the transition; it does not require starting Operation 03 content in this step.

If Magic Lamp was missed, the invitation flow can still become available — complete what remains and note the failed lamp outcome rather than treating the chain as fully recommended-complete.

Nearby loot route — individual stops and walkthroughs.

Keira · follow-up chain

Useful quest rewards and a consequential companion choice.

Recommended · Fyke Isle · suggested 6

Goal / requirement: Receive the lamp / Xenovox and the Fyke Isle quest from Keira.

Payoff: Quest rewards; Keira follow-up

Cutoff / caution: Investigate fully before resolving the spirit’s request; decision help is spoiler-gated.

Walkthrough & help — quest / encounter spoilers
Use the lamp at hauntings; investigate each floor. Witcher Senses reveal the hidden upper passage and its lever. Do not resolve the spirit’s request solely from its first account. Tower route / map.
Decision help — outcome spoilers

Recommendation: refuse to carry the bones away; follow the resulting investigation and bring Graham to the tower. This resolves the curse there rather than releasing the spirit. It is not a no-casualty outcome. Source.

Payoff: For the Advancement of Learning

Recover the requested package, then return for the outing. Romance is not required for the subsequent quest. Do wanted shopping before concluding Keira’s chain.

Recommended · Fyke Isle tower · suggested 8

Payoff: Potential future ally

Cutoff / caution: Consequential conversation; complete Keira’s chain before the later Isle of Mists warning.

Walkthrough & help — quest / encounter spoilers
Visit Fyke Isle again after the outing. The conversation can permanently determine a future ally.
Preserve the ally — dialogue spoilers

Recommendation: challenge the Radovid plan, explain the danger and offer Kaer Morhen. A corroborated route is “What’s with the notes?” → “Radovid never forgets.” → “It’s suicide.” → “Go to Kaer Morhen.” Read the actual prompts and avoid threatening to fight her. Source.

Before moving on — a checkpoint, not a departure lock

Travel between Velen, Oxenfurt and Novigrad as your goals require. There is no single White Orchard-style departure conversation that closes all Velen business.

Later hard stop: when sailing toward the Isle of Mists, the game presents a story / unavailable-quests warning. Review unresolved regional and companion quests before confirming that warning. Do not confuse receiving the quest or visiting Novigrad with crossing that point. [Cutoff reference]
  • Eye obtained and usable Magic Lamp handoff understood.
  • Keira / Baron follow-ups completed or explicitly kept in your journal for later.
  • Current sword and next crafting purchase make sense for your level and crowns.
  • Feline targets collected or deferred for a stated readiness reason.
  • Nearby power, capacity and selected contract opportunities completed or intentionally deferred.
Optional sets and later investments

Griffin diagrams become an optional medium-armor / Signs alternative; they are not parallel homework for this light sword build. Check the alternative-school trade-offs before buying materials. Keep later Wolven / Ursine options on that page.

Master Armorers, Hattori’s sword service and later Feline tiers remain staged service goals. Grandmaster costs, Runewright funding and mutation research are not opening-Velen bills.

Devil’s Pit / In the Eternal Fire’s Shadow and higher-level contracts may already be visible. Read the live level and prepare deliberately; availability is not readiness.

Skills, prerequisites & active slots
QuestionCheckWhat to do
Can I buy it?Read the connected prerequisite on the node.Learn the required connection and buy the rank your build lists. Older tree-spend thresholds are not the Remastered unlock rule.
How many points?One point buys one rank; 3/3 means three total.If you own 2/3, one more point reaches 3/3. A later return row buys only missing ranks.
Is it active?Read the node’s activation requirements.A purchase does not automatically activate every effect. Put slot-dependent skills in an unlocked active square.
Where do I equip it?Use an open skill square; the adjacent diamond is for a mutagen.Follow your school page’s Equip / Replace / Restore instructions.
The active slots are fullPurchase access and active-slot space are separate.Keep legal prerequisite purchases learned; equip the useful selection your current slots allow.

What does BANK mean?Your build is waiting on a named gate.Reserve the stated points, continue where the plan permits, and return when the gate is met.
Do I need a skill for a basic Sign?All five basic casts exist without Sign-tree purchases.Purchased upgrades and alternate modes have their own activation requirements.

Level-upsOne point per gained level.A build’s purchase sequence is not a fixed character-level schedule.

Optional point reward — base-game story spoilers

Magic Acorn: loot Imlerith after the Bald Mountain confrontation and consume the acorn for two ability points. Giving it away gives up those points. Returning later may still allow collection; this is not labelled an automatic departure failure.

Optional point reward — Blood and Wine route spoilers

Golden Egg: on the Land of a Thousand Fables route, complete Duck, Duck, Goosed! and consume the egg before leaving the realm for one point. Its departure cutoff still needs independent Xbox 5.01 field confirmation.

Color / typeBase benefitPlacement

OutputConsumed inputsWhere

Prerequisites & leveling guidance
SituationWhat to do
Tree connectionsMuscle Memory → Three Strikes → Undying → Fleet-Footed → Whirl → Crippling Strike. Three Strikes also opens Razor Focus. Arrow Deflection 1/3 opens Resolve. One learned prerequisite rank opens the next connected node.
Cat School Techniques BANKBuy/equip the reserved ranks when useful light pieces and a slot are available. It can work before level 17; the armor needs to be light, not necessarily Feline. Do not equip a weak item just to match the name.
Slots are fullBuying an unlocked skill does not require an empty active slot. Follow the temporary REPLACE instructions in the table; restore displaced skills as slots open. Final build shows all 12.
DelusionA convenience choice in this candidate, not a Feline requirement. Keep it equipped for dialogue checks; it does not guarantee every Axii option succeeds.
Not enough points after a respecRebuild from the first unfinished target. Buy prerequisite-only ranks too. Main final uses 37 ordinary points: 36 in active skills + Arrow Deflection 1/3 inactive.
A node differs in your gameStop at that node and read its live prerequisite/rank description. This candidate targets Remastered 5.01, not the old tier-spend tree.
Why these skills?
SkillPractical payoff
Muscle MemoryDodge or roll successfully, then use the boosted fast-attack follow-up.
Three StrikesSupports short same-type attack strings; do not stay exposed just to chase its trigger.
WhirlCrowd punish during a safe opening; sustained use spends Stamina and Adrenaline.
Crippling StrikeFast-attack critical hits apply a damage-taken debuff; it is not the classic bleeding skill.
Razor Focus / ResolveStart building Adrenaline sooner and retain it better when hit.
Undying / Fleet-FootedAdrenaline-dependent emergency recovery and protection during dodges; neither is permission to trade hits.
Exploding ShieldPushback when Quen breaks; this is not Active Shield healing.
RefreshmentPotion doses also restore Vitality; check Toxicity before drinking.
Cat School TechniquesUses light-armor pieces to support fast attacks and critical damage.

Mutagen upgrades & sourcing
  1. Slot the strongest useful ordinary mutagens you already own.
  2. Check Alchemy to combine Lesser → ordinary → Greater; read the actual ingredients.
  3. Keep named monster mutagens you may need for decoctions.
  4. Reserve 2 Greater red for the main mutation path, or 5 Greater green for the Euphoria branch below.

ItemUseWhen
ThunderboltSword Attack PowerTougher fights where damage is the problem.

Use versions already crafted and check Toxicity before combining doses. No specific decoction is required. Euphoria uses controlled Toxicity; its branch explains the swap.

Endgame progression — mutations & extra slots
OrderSpend / researchGate and next action
1Deadly Counter: 2 points + 2 Greater redAfter Turn and Face the Strange. Research and activate; ordinary skills stay unchanged. Main total: 39.
2Bloodbath: 3 points + 3 Greater redNeeds Deadly Counter. Activate only if its avoid-damage rhythm suits you. Two researched mutations unlock the first extra slot; active red mutation permits Combat skills.
3Rend 3/3: 3 pointsWhirl or Razor Focus already unlocks it. Put Rend in that first extra slot. Use it for a longer safe punish; do not remove Whirl. Main total after these three steps: 45.
More pointsBANK pending later-slot planFurther research opens slots at 4 / 8 / 12 researched mutations. Exact later research order and assignments remain a labelled hold; this page does not pretend the 45-point stage spends every possible first-run point.

Research and activation are separate. Only one mutation is active; its colors restrict extra slots. Ordinary mutagens stay beside the normal skill groups. Euphoria follows its own fresh path below, not this red research order.

Combat — how to play

  1. Prepare: match the oil and cast Quen when useful.
  2. Evade: let the attack commit; dodge into a safe angle.
  3. Punish: land short fast-attack strings. Use Whirl only when the surrounding enemies and resources allow it.
  4. Leave: release Whirl and reposition before the next attack or resource failure.
Combat setup & troubleshooting
ProblemAdjustment
Whirl gets interruptedCreate the opening first. It is a punish, not protection or a way to enter every crowd.
Running out of resourcesRelease early; leave room to evade and recover. Tawny Owl can help recovery, but does not make Whirl free.
Taking heavy damageRepair gear; shorten strings; use Quen and the right oil. Light armor still rewards avoiding hits.
Undying did not save meIt needs its active skill, Adrenaline and its available trigger. Do not treat it as unconditional extra health.
Shield brokeReset and recast when safe. Exploding Shield is pushback, not the held healing shield.

BUILD + PROGRESSION + GEAR · GRIFFIN PILOT R1 · REVIEW

Griffin

Playstyle
Medium-armor Sign caster: build a Yrden field, alternate useful Signs and punish safe openings.
Payoff
Control and Sign damage from early Velen, with later Grandmaster casting and field bonuses.
Tradeoff
Positioning and Stamina matter. You must adapt when enemies leave the field or resist your preferred tool.

SituationWhat to do
Main unlock routeSustained Glyphs → Magic Trap → Supercharged Glyphs → Catalyst → Chain Reaction → Aftershock → Resonance. One learned prerequisite rank opens the next node.
Defense / resource routeExploding Shield → Active Shield. Supercharged Glyphs → Fortify Signs → Sidestep. Buying an unlocked node does not require a free active slot.
School skill bankedBuy/equip the reserved 3 ranks when useful medium pieces and a slot are available. You can use this before Griffin armor; medium weight is the condition, not the set name.
Limited slotsFollow temporary REPLACE instructions. Restore Sustained Glyphs and Exploding Shield as slots open; Final build contains the full 12. Equipping a replacement does not erase its learned prerequisite.
Basic vs alternate castAll five basic Signs are already available. Magic Trap and Active Shield require their learned, equipped skills and the alternate cast input. Casting controls →

Live node disagreesStop at that node. This candidate uses the connected Remastered 5.01 tree, not old tier-spend thresholds; field-test discrepancies stay open.
Why these skills?
Skill / groupPractical benefit
Sustained Glyphs / Magic TrapA longer-lasting Yrden field plus its alternate damage/control trap.
Supercharged GlyphsAdds ongoing damage to enemies affected by Yrden.
CatalystStrengthens Aard and Igni against enemies inside Yrden.
Chain ReactionAlternate useful Signs; repeating the same Sign does not advance its different-Sign condition.
Aftershock / ResonanceNearby cast damage and a sword follow-up after casting; close distance only when safe.
Exploding / Active ShieldShield-break pushback and a distinct held shield that can restore Vitality from absorbed damage.
Fortify Signs / SidestepLonger utility effects and a lower-cost next Sign after a successful evade.
Griffin School TechniquesMedium pieces support Sign intensity and Stamina recovery; it has no mutagen color.

Basic Griffin diagrams — locations & collection route
StopLocationCollectRoute

Hindhold — steel sword
  1. Reach the ruin north of Hanged Man’s Tree; handle the endregas and climb.
  2. Clear the harpies above; search the small upper room for the diagram.
Lornruk — underwater entrance and silver sword
  1. The raised/broken bridge is not your entrance. Descend toward the Place of Power and water below the lighthouse.
  2. Dive into the underwater tunnel, watch for drowners and follow it into the cave. Climb inside the structure.
  3. Search the upper area near the tower for the diagram. A wyvern patrols above; the equip level is not a safe-encounter guarantee.
Dragonslayer’s Grotto — four armor diagrams
  1. Enter the cave northwest of Downwarren. Prepare for wraiths and poison gas; keep space when clearing gas.
  2. Use Aard on the blocked wall; defeat the ekimmara beyond.
  3. Search the tomb chest beyond the fight for all four armor diagrams. Confirm the four pieces before leaving.

Combat — how to play

  1. Prepare: cast Quen when useful; place Yrden where you can keep the fight.
  2. Control: set Magic Trap when you have time. Keep enemies inside the standard Yrden field for Catalyst.
  3. Cast: use Igni where fire works, Aard where an opening helps, and alternate useful Signs for Chain Reaction.
  4. Follow up: use short sword attacks after a cast when safe, then evade and recover. Do not enter melee merely to force Aftershock.
Combat setup & troubleshooting
ProblemAdjustment
Enemies leave YrdenReposition or replace the field; Catalyst needs the target inside it. A ground effect is not a fixed arena you must die defending.
Igni is resistedChange the tool: Yrden damage, Aard control or safe sword attacks. No universal burn promise.
Cannot cast / no StaminaEvade, recover and use Sidestep’s next-cast opening. Tawny Owl helps recovery, not unlimited casting.
Active Shield will not healCheck skill equipped, alternate cast input and that damage was actually absorbed; basic Quen is different.
Grandmaster follow-up castUse a standard cast within the three-piece bonus window; do not assume an alternate held cast is free.
Whirl variant resourcesWhirl competes with casting and Adrenaline. Release early rather than losing your next defensive option.

Combat change: favor Aard against targets in Yrden. Aard Sweep and freezing are not guaranteed instant kills; use the safe opening they actually create.

Whirling Griffin — sword and Sign hybrid

Keep the Yrden/casting core and add a deliberate sword fallback. Trade Active Shield, Fortify Signs and Sidestep for Muscle Memory, Whirl and Razor Focus. Basic Quen remains available.
