BUILD + PROGRESSION + GEAR · PILOT 3 / REVIEW

Ursine / Bear

Deliberate sword attacks with a defensive heavy-armor foundation.

Strengths: strong-attack openings, Adrenaline support and several defensive tools.
Tradeoff: slower Stamina recovery in heavy armor; protection does not make trading hits a safe default.

Completed loadout · main build candidate

All ordinary skills at 3/3: Strength Training, Crushing Blow, Rend, Bear School Techniques, Three Strikes, Undying, Fleet-Footed, Razor Focus, Muscle Memory, Resolve, Refreshment and Arrow Deflection.

Equipment: four useful Ursine heavy armor pieces, progressing to Grandmaster at level 40; steel and silver swords chosen by live comparison, with Ursine swords as the school candidates. Do not convert armor weight on this path.

Mutation: Deadly Counter after its Blood and Wine unlock. Supplies: chosen healing potion, matching oil, situational bomb; Tawny Owl only if needed and toxicity permits. No decoction is required.

Mutagens: use the visible placement section. Enchantments and a priced socket package await LT’s audit.

Fresh character → completed base skills → Blood and Wine

Candidate: 36 skill points + 2 mutation points = 38. Finish each listed target before the next row unless its gate tells you to bank. Extra Place of Power points advance this same order.

Limited slots, banking and extra points

Slot priority: Strength Training → Crushing Blow → Rend → Bear School Techniques when useful heavy armor is equipped → Three Strikes → Undying → Fleet-Footed → Razor Focus → Muscle Memory → Resolve → Refreshment → Arrow Deflection. Use only as many as your unlocked slots allow.

Banking: reserve a named purchase only when its requirement is unmet. Never spend points on filler just to advance a total. Keep the active loadout distinct from purchased prerequisites.

After this candidate’s 38 points: bank surplus for further mutation research until LT completes the source-by-source first-playthrough budget and the additional-slot assignments. This is an explicit research hold, not a claim that all possible first-playthrough points have been allocated. NG+ is out of scope.

Oil-supported alternative

Coated Bear has its own fresh-start order and conversion below. It is a first-choice option, not a reward for finishing the main path.

First-set route — locations, access & danger

Diagram collection is separate from combat readiness and equip level. The main armor route contains wraiths; assess actual enemy levels. The Kaer Trolde armorer’s maps can start the hunts, but direct collection is also possible.

  1. Four armor diagrams: reach Urialla Harbor on An Skellig. Follow the northern trail toward the ruined fortress by Yngvar’s Fang. Enter its dungeon, use the cell-opening lever, then take the broken-floor cell route to the chest chamber. Wraiths guard the route. Loot the armor, trousers, gauntlets and boots diagrams.
  2. Steel sword: the Ruined Inn east of Fyresdal, on Ard Skellig. Search its cellar; expect wraiths.
  3. Silver sword: Fort Etnir, north of Rogne on Ard Skellig. Search the skeleton in the ruins. Gargoyles and a substantially stronger ice elemental are reported nearby; the guarded-treasure marker is not the diagram itself.
  4. Crossbow: separate level-29 item. It is not needed to begin wearing the level-20 armor.

Stopping point: the needed diagrams are collected and the useful pieces are funded. Owning six diagrams is not a requirement to buy six crafts immediately.

Crafting handoff & a chest-only budget

Armor: a suitable Journeyman armorer such as Fergus at Crow’s Perch. Swords: a suitable Journeyman blacksmith such as the east-side Oxenfurt smith. Inspect the displayed rank for the individual recipe.

Basic chest example: 1 shirt, 2 hardened leather, 1 dark steel plate, 4 linen and 1 monster bone. Price the fee and missing inputs together; buy or dismantle only after comparing the actual panel.

Craft the items that help now, then retain your current Ursine tier for its next recipes. Provider reference · Sell / dismantle / retain.

Mastercrafted armor uses Yoana after Master Armorers; Master swords use Hattori after Of Swords and Dumplings. Grandmaster crafting is Lafargue in Toussaint. Intermediate service requirements and exact prices should be read from the live panel.

Later armor targets — named diagram clusters

These are collection targets, not a safe low-level circuit. Sword diagrams have separate locations.

  • Enhanced armor: southeast Ard Skellig grotto (chest); cave northwest of Kaer Muire (boots); ruined watchtower northeast of Rogne (gauntlets); island north of Undvik (trousers).
  • Superior armor: the monster den north of Mulbrydale in Velen holds the four armor diagrams.
  • Mastercrafted armor: the Destroyed Bastion chest in Velen holds the four armor diagrams. Collection does not make you ready for other encounters there.
  • Grandmaster: Flovive’s ruined-house cellar and the cave northwest of Flovive split the armor and sword diagrams. Talk to Lafargue for the hunt.

Full pin-by-pin upgrade routes and six-piece component ledgers are outside this first profile pilot.

Sockets, crossbow and purchases you can defer

Use spare compatible runestones or glyphs when their live effect helps; do not buy expensive upgrades for a temporary item just to fill every socket. This pilot does not prescribe a tested best-in-slot socket package. Compare the actual tooltip before committing.

Keep your usable crossbow. The Ursine crossbow is a separate level-29 item, not a requirement for this armor-and-sword baseline. Horse gear and trophies are utility choices, not prerequisites. Runewright enchantments, armor-weight conversion and mutations need their own complete loadout audit.

Mutagens — color, bonus, placement

Use what you own; improve matching when available. Match active skills in the connected group. General skills add no color match.

  • Three red groups → red mutagens: place the nine red skills other than Arrow Deflection across these groups. Red supports sword Attack Power.
  • Mixed group → compare the live bonus: Arrow Deflection + Refreshment + Bear School Techniques. Red boosts attack; green supports Vitality. Choose the useful bonus rather than forcing weak skills into a color match.
  • Until red drops: use a useful mutagen you own. Red skills do not amplify a green mutagen; its base Vitality bonus can still help.
  • Upgrade: Lesser → ordinary → Greater when inputs are available. Retain named monster mutagens for potential decoctions and reserve the Greater reds needed by the mutation plan.
Variants and the Blood and Wine distinction

Mobile Bear: Whirl replaces red Rend, retaining that group’s color match. Coated Bear: Protective Coating replaces Arrow Deflection in the mixed group. Pair Coating + Refreshment with a green mutagen; Bear School Techniques has no color.

Ordinary mutagens go in the diamond-shaped group positions. A researched Blood and Wine mutation is a different system. Read the Alchemy upgrade inputs; do not consume a needed equipped mutagen blindly.

03 / MAKE IT WORK

Open → prepare → punish → reset.

Evade or defend an attack. When safe, land a fast attack, follow with a strong attack, then reassess. Reserve Rend for a genuine opening; heavy armor does not make trading every hit worthwhile.

Combat setup & troubleshooting
  • Core connection: active Strength Training rewards a fast attack before the strong follow-up. Crushing Blow can improve subsequent strong attacks; it is not a reason to force a fixed combo length.
  • Rend: use the strong-attack charge input in your selected controls. It spends Stamina; the current reference also describes an Adrenaline-based damage contribution. Create space before spending the resource you need for another action.
  • Preparation: matching oil, a chosen healing potion and basic Quen when useful. Basic Quen does not require a purchased Sign skill. Add Tawny Owl only when Stamina support solves a real problem and toxicity permits it.
  • Too exposed? shorten the punish. Too slow? use fast attacks for brief openings. Coating doing nothing? check the equipped skill and matching oil.

Defensive choices · Healing and potion options · Oil / sword matching.

LT review brief · candidate, not a tested final build

Review the whole pilot, not only player-reported errors. Preserve the locked Combat section. Check every rank and prerequisite, the purchase totals and 12-slot final loadouts; pressure-test the variant exchanges and mixed mutagen group.

Open deliverables: finish the attainable first-playthrough point-source budget; explicitly allocate surplus beyond this candidate into mutation research and extra skill slots; verify the final equipment/socket package and named temporary alternatives by level and access. Do not label this an all-possible-points plan until those hold items are resolved.

Usability test: find next purchase, its activation action, next armor gate and one variant conversion without reading the full page. Check phone Safari wrapping, search/deep links, Back and saved checklist progress. Player review is a usability pass, not independent mechanics verification.

Confirm live requirements before spending; exact slot thresholds, realistic full-run point income, extra-slot research and the final socket package remain LT review items.

SituationWhat to do
Sword unlock routeMuscle Memory → Three Strikes → Undying → Fleet-Footed → Whirl. Three Strikes also opens Razor Focus. One learned prerequisite rank opens the connected node.
Sign unlock routeSustained Glyphs → Magic Trap → Supercharged Glyphs → Catalyst → Focus → Aftershock → Resonance.
Main prerequisite-only ranksUndying 1/3 and Aftershock 1/3 stay learned but inactive at the ordinary final stage. Inactive Undying gives no emergency recovery. Aftershock returns in the first extra slot later.
Limited slotsBuying an unlocked skill does not require a free active slot. Follow the temporary REPLACE rows; restore Three Strikes, Sustained Glyphs and Magic Trap when space allows.
Wolf School Techniques bankedBuy/equip the reserved ranks with useful medium armor and a slot. It does not require Wolven-branded gear or Kaer Morhen access.
Basic Signs / alternate trapAll five basic Signs are available without Sign-tree purchases. Magic Trap needs its learned, equipped skill and the alternate Yrden input. Basic Quen remains available. Casting controls →
Fresh start / respecCompare owned ranks with the first unfinished target. Main costs 38 ordinary points: 36 in active skills + 2 inactive prerequisite ranks.
Live node differsStop at that node. This candidate targets Remastered 5.01 connections, not the old tier-spend tree.
Why these skills?
Skill / groupPractical benefit
Muscle Memory / Three StrikesFast-attack follow-ups after evasion and support for short same-type strings.
Fleet-Footed / WhirlProtection during dodging and a crowd punish when the opening is safe. Whirl is not defensive immunity.
Razor Focus / FocusStart building Adrenaline sooner; retained Adrenaline supports Sign intensity. Spending it on Whirl can reduce that Sign benefit.
Yrden tools / CatalystA useful ground field, alternate trap and damage support for Aard/Igni against targets inside the field.
ResonanceCasting supports a short melee follow-up. Exact interaction with every Whirl tick is not assumed.
Wolf School TechniquesMedium armor supports weapons and Signs together. General skills provide no mutagen color match.

  1. Climb into the ruined tower and read Hieronymus’ Notes from the chest.
  2. Find the missing crystal outside the north wall; return and place it in its holder.
  3. Use Aard on both power crystals, including the one already in place. Enter the completed portal.
  4. Handle the wraith in the cave below and loot the remains for all four armor diagrams.

  1. Reach the old training ruins west of Kaer Morhen; prepare for wraiths.
  2. Search the remains among the central courtyard’s ruined wooden structure for the steel sword diagram.

Research and activation differ. You do not have to activate Piercing Cold to research Conductors. Magic Sensibilities allows blue extra skills; Conductors allows red and blue. Never equip a second copy of a skill already active.

Combat — how to play

  1. Prepare: match the oil; basic Quen is available. Place Yrden where the fight can stay.
  2. Cast: Aard or Igni against a suitable target inside Yrden; use the opening you actually create.
  3. Punish: evade → short fast-attack string. Whirl is for a safe crowd opening, not every approach.
  4. Reset: release Whirl before resources or spacing fail; recover and cast again when useful.
Combat setup & troubleshooting
ProblemAdjustment
No Adrenaline / weak Focus benefitRazor Focus and sword hits help build it. Long Whirl use consumes Adrenaline; the hybrid has a resource tradeoff.
Enemy leaves YrdenReposition the field or change the tool. Catalyst needs its target inside Yrden.
Cannot castRecover Stamina instead of extending Whirl. Basic Quen is not a free emergency cast with an empty resource bar.
Undying did nothingOn this main path it is learned but inactive. Dodge, spacing and Quen are the active defensive tools.
Whirl / Resonance interactionUse the normal safe sword follow-up; exact per-tick behavior is a research hold, not a promised multiplier.
Grandmaster bleeding bonusCheck an actual bleeding source on the weapon/tool. Do not infer bleeding from old Crippling Strike descriptions.

BUILD + PROGRESSION + GEAR · VIPER PILOT R1 · REVIEW

Viper

Playstyle
Medium-armor poison-and-sword fighter, with fast openings, a strong-attack payoff and Whirl for safe crowds.
Payoff
Oil-supported pressure, potion healing and a conditional poison burst; the sword core works before late Viper gear.
Tradeoff
Poison depends on chance and susceptibility. Branded armor arrives at 39, and Hearts of Stone rewards have missable windows.

Prerequisites & leveling guidance
SituationWhat to do
Sword connectionsMuscle Memory → Strength Training; Muscle Memory → Three Strikes → Undying → Fleet-Footed → Whirl. Three Strikes also opens Razor Focus.
Poison connectionsFrenzy → Poisoned Blades → Toxic Shock → Debilitating Poison. One learned rank opens the connected node; its effect still needs activation.
Protection connectionRefreshment → Pyrotechnics → Protective Coating. Main keeps Pyrotechnics 1/3 learned but inactive.
Viper Techniques bankedBuy/equip with useful medium armor and a free slot. It works with medium armor from other schools; you do not need level-39 Viper pieces first.
Limited slotsPurchase is not blocked by a full active grid. Follow temporary REPLACE rows; restore Three Strikes and Frenzy as slots open. The final list has 12 ordinary skills.
Frenzy / Undying conditionsFrenzy needs potion Toxicity above its trigger. Undying needs its live Adrenaline and cooldown conditions; neither guarantees safety.
Basic SignsAll five basic casts are available without Sign-tree purchases. This main build uses basic Quen and situational Signs without assigning a blue skill slot. Casting controls →
Fresh / respec37 ordinary points includes all 36 active ranks and inactive Pyrotechnics 1/3. Do not add three ranks again when a skill reappears.
Live node differsStop at that node. This candidate targets Remastered 5.01 connections, not the old tier-spend tree.
Why these skills?
Skill / groupPractical benefit
Muscle Memory / Strength TrainingEvade into fast hits, then use a safe strong opening. They support sword damage even when poison fails.
Poisoned Blades / Toxic ShockOil-coated hits can establish poison; a strong hit consumes an existing poison for a burst. It is not a guaranteed first-hit combo.
Viper School TechniquesMedium pieces improve Vitality and poison damage. General skills add no mutagen color match.
Refreshment / CoatingPotion healing and oil-category protection; both still need their conditions and active skills.
Whirl / Fleet-FootedA safe crowd punish plus dodge protection. Whirl does not make you invulnerable.
Three Strikes / UndyingSupport for same-type strings and conditional emergency recovery. Do not force a third hit into an unsafe opening.

Story spoilers — choice & collection route
StepDo this
1In Whatsoever a Man Soweth…, intervening on Olgierd’s behalf and challenging Gaunter can open the riddle world. The optional Shani/professor investigation provides the information needed for that challenge.
2Leave the starting area heading north. At the first junction turn right and cross the bridge; at the second turn left, then left again at the third. Defeat the specter guarding the sword in stone and pull it out.
3Resume the riddle objective before time expires. This is the actual Venomous silver weapon; confirm the pickup.
4If you chose another ending or left without it, keep a stronger usable silver sword. There is no standard vendor replacement; do not change a story choice solely because this guide uses a Viper theme.

The route follows GameBanshee; live timer margin and physical map pins are not field-tested here. Make the save before the choice, not after entering the timed branch.

Research is separate from activation. Only one mutation is active. Bloodbath permits Combat extra skills; never add a second active copy of a skill. Lingering Viper and Euphoria Viper have their own first-extra-skill instructions below.

Combat — how to play

  1. Prepare: oil for the enemy category; basic Quen when useful.
  2. Open: evade → short fast hits. Keep an exit from groups.
  3. Cash out: if poison is actually present and a strong opening is safe, use a strong hit for Toxic Shock. Respect its cooldown.
  4. Reset: use Whirl for a safe crowd opening; release before spacing or resources fail. If poison will not apply, rely on the sword loop.
Combat setup & troubleshooting
ProblemAdjustment
Poison never appearsCheck active Poisoned Blades, oil and target susceptibility. Proc behavior on live Xbox 5.01 is a hold; do not promise a guaranteed result or added proc percentages.
Toxic Shock does nothingIt needs an already poisoned target, an active skill, a strong hit and the cooldown ready. No poison means no consume burst.
Poison-immune enemyUse sword damage, category oil and the Bestiary’s useful tools. Do not wait for a poison trigger that cannot happen.
Whirl drains resourcesUse shorter windows; disengage to recover. Undying also depends on its resource conditions.
Taking too much damageCheck armor condition, oil match for Coating and spacing. Medium weight alone is not universal mitigation.
Considering Potent StingIts deeper prerequisite path and exact interaction with weapon poison are not included in this candidate. Do not infer its effect from the school name.

BUILD + PROGRESSION + GEAR · MANTICORE PILOT R1 · REVIEW

Manticore

Playstyle
Medium-armor bomb-and-sword alchemist: throw for a purpose, then exploit the opening.
Payoff
More useful bomb stock, fragments, potion healing and a sword fallback. Three Manticore pieces add the late bomb-critical milestone.
Tradeoff
Needs formulas, refills and Toxicity management. The actual set arrives at 40 in Toussaint; fragments and status effects are not guaranteed against every target.

Prerequisites & leveling guidance
SituationWhat to do
Bomb unlock routeEfficiency → Pyrotechnics → Protective Coating → Volatile Compound → Cluster Bombs. Refreshment also opens Pyrotechnics. One learned prerequisite rank opens its connected node.
General connectionsManticore School Techniques opens Element of Surprise. Viper School Techniques 1/3 separately opens Advanced Pyrotechnics; that Viper rank stays inactive.
Sword / dodge routeMuscle Memory → Three Strikes → Undying → Fleet-Footed. Main keeps Three Strikes and Undying at 1/3 inactive; they do not supply their effects.
Tolerance routeRefreshment or Efficiency → Hunter Instinct → Acquired Tolerance. Main leaves Hunter Instinct 1/3 inactive. Capacity depends on recipes actually learned.
Limited slotsPurchase does not require a free active slot. Temporarily replace Pyrotechnics for Cluster Bombs and Efficiency for Acquired Tolerance; restore both as slots open.
Medium armor gateManticore Techniques can work with useful medium pieces from other schools. Start its prerequisite at 1/3; bank the remaining 2 if the armor / slot benefit is not ready.
No usable bombs yetBank bomb-specific spending until you craft a bomb worth using. Continue Muscle Memory and the Three Strikes → Undying → Fleet-Footed route; no need to force Toussaint.
Basic SignsBasic Quen and the other basic casts need no Sign-tree purchase. No blue skill slot is assumed here. Casting controls →
Budget40 ordinary points: 36 active ranks + four inactive 1/3 prerequisites (Viper Techniques, Hunter Instinct, Three Strikes, Undying). Extra Places of Power advance the same order.
Live tree differsStop at the mismatch. This candidate targets Remastered 5.01 connections, not the old tier-spend system.
Why these skills?
Skill / groupPractical benefit
Efficiency / Pyrotechnics / Cluster BombsMore stock, additional bomb damage and fragments. Do not assume every fragment hits one target or every bomb applies every status.
Protective Coating / RefreshmentOil-category protection and healing from potion doses; use the conditions, not reckless trading.
Volatile Compound / Acquired ToleranceBomb scaling with current Toxicity; learned recipes can increase capacity. Capacity is not immunity to overdose.
Manticore Techniques / Element of SurpriseMedium armor supports bomb and sword damage; a bomb hit creates a short melee damage window.
Advanced PyrotechnicsThrown-bomb damage protection and a chance to preserve charges; not a promise of immunity to all gas, fire or battlefield hazards.
Muscle Memory / Fleet-FootedFast-attack follow-up after evasion and protection during dodging; no active Undying rescue on this main path.

Manticore diagrams — Toussaint collection route

All six diagrams are in Toussaint. Ask Lafargue about Manticore for the hunt and quest markers. Collection order is flexible; these five stops are not a promise of safe fights before level 40.

1Steel swordBastoy Prison Ruins northwest of Beauclair: climb the ruined tower and search the upper prison cell.

  1. Find the partly submerged entrance south of the Palace Gardens; follow the cave passage.
  2. Prepare for vampires, then give alms to the beggar apparitions.
  3. Defeat the kikimores; follow the narrow northwest passage and break the weak wall.
  4. Loot the final chest for the silver diagram and notes. These are diagrams, not ready-made swords.

Bomb stock & formula progression
StepDo this
1Find or buy a formula you will use; check herbalists / alchemists and owned Alchemy recipes. Do not assume a random loot chest guarantees it.

Combat — how to play

  1. Prepare: category oil, useful bomb and a safe potion plan; basic Quen when useful.
  2. Throw: hit with the bomb that solves this enemy’s problem; keep distance from uncontrolled hazards.
  3. Follow: evade into a short fast-attack opening while Element of Surprise is active.
  4. Reset: disengage before the reply. Conserve bombs when the sword already finishes the job; refill between encounters.
Combat setup & troubleshooting
ProblemAdjustment
Bombs do not critThe equipped three-piece Manticore bonus is the gate; Techniques alone does not grant it. Exact critical / fragment behavior remains a live-test hold.
Bomb feels weakCheck target resistance, actual formula tier and active skills. Four fragments do not promise four hits on one enemy.
Charges run outUse the sword for cleanup, keep Efficiency active, and replenish when safe. Advanced Pyrotechnics conservation is a chance.
My own explosion / gas hurtsVerify Advanced Pyrotechnics is active. Its damage protection does not establish immunity to every lingering status or environmental hazard.
No emergency revivalUndying is inactive prerequisite spending here. Use Quen, dodges, spacing and recovery.
High Toxicity hurtsStop stacking; inspect the safe threshold, active effects and clearing options. More capacity is not permission to overdose.
Metamorphosis instead?That research branch and controlled decoction setup are not allocated in R1. Do not switch mutations and assume Euphoria’s extra-slot plan still applies unchanged.

BUILD + PROGRESSION + GEAR · FORGOTTEN WOLVEN PILOT R1 · REVIEW

Forgotten Wolven

Playstyle
Medium-armor Aard/Yrden caster: hold a useful field, create control and punish with the right cast.
Payoff
A working Sign loop before the set, then a six-piece Grandmaster payoff for Aard against Yrden-affected enemies.
Tradeoff
Field positioning, Stamina and enemy susceptibility matter. Gear access and level are separate; this is not ordinary Wolven gear.

Prerequisites & leveling guidance
SituationWhat to do
Aard / Yrden connectionsSustained Glyphs → Magic Trap → Shockwave or Supercharged Glyphs. Far-Reaching Aard independently opens Aard Sweep. One learned prerequisite rank opens a connected node.
Advanced connectionsShockwave or Supercharged Glyphs → Catalyst → Chain Reaction → Aftershock. Supercharged Glyphs → Fortify Signs → Sidestep also opens Aftershock.
Why Griffin Techniques?This is intentional: it improves medium-armor Sign intensity / recovery. Gear branding does not require Wolf School Techniques; this profile prioritizes casting.
Medium gateUse useful medium pieces already owned. You do not need Forgotten Wolven gear before the technique can work. Bank its 3 points if the armor / slot benefit is not ready.
Limited slotsBuy unlocked skills even if the active grid is full. Temporarily replace Far-Reaching Aard for Aftershock; restore it as space opens.
Basic vs alternateAll five basic casts are available without buying nodes. Aard Sweep and Magic Trap need their purchased, active skills and alternate inputs. Casting controls →
SurvivalMain has basic Quen but no active Active Shield, Refreshment or Undying. Do not assume healing or revival from an unpurchased / inactive skill.
Fresh / respecMain uses 36 ordinary points, all in its 12 final active skills. Owned ranks determine your first incomplete row.
Live tree differsStop at that node. This candidate targets Remastered 5.01 connections, not old tier-point unlocks.
Why these skills?
Skill / groupPractical benefit
Aard skills / ShockwaveDirectional and radial Aard choices plus damage support; not every enemy can be knocked down or frozen.
Yrden field / Magic TrapA place to fight and an alternate trap; keep the relevant target affected rather than casting at empty ground.
CatalystAard / Igni support against targets inside Yrden. The core uses Aard; Igni stays situational.
Fortify / SidestepLonger useful effects and cheaper next casting after successful evasion. They do not eliminate all resource limits.
Chain Reaction / AftershockUseful Sign alternation and nearby casting damage. Do not move into danger just for a small-radius hit.
Griffin TechniquesMedium armor casting support, separate from Grandmaster equipped-set effects.

Basic diagrams — Devil’s Pit quest

Speak to the Eternal Fire deacon at Devil’s Pit in Velen and complete In the Eternal Fire’s Shadow. The six Basic diagrams are a quest reward; they are not six separate chest hunts. Equip at 20 once crafting is ready.

Quest / encounter spoilers — mine and boss steps
StepDo this
1Enter the mine and investigate the notes before rushing to the voice.
2Explore the side passages for evidence and the philter information; prepare before the final chamber.
3Against possessed Reinald, place Yrden and use Aard while he is in the ring; evade his replies rather than trading long strings.
4Defeat the released Red Miasmal and its summons, then finish the conversation. Check for all four armor diagrams and both sword diagrams.

Full dialogue outcomes, optional evidence and exact live encounter tuning are not exhaustively covered by this short build route. The illustrated walkthrough is under Sources.

Combat — how to play

  1. Prepare: basic Quen when useful; choose space where the target can remain in Yrden.
  2. Set: place Yrden and use Magic Trap when its alternate mode helps.
  3. Cast: evade → Aard against the affected target. Use directional Aard or Sweep for the actual opening.
  4. Reset: reposition and recover; take a short sword hit only when safe. Do not chase control-immune enemies with endless failed knockdowns.

ProblemAdjustment
Target leaves YrdenReposition the field; Catalyst needs the target inside it, and the full-set effect needs Yrden influence.
Aard does little earlyBasic Aard control is not the entire late damage package. Check active Shockwave, relevant skills and actual enemy resistance.
No instant freeze killPiercing Cold is conditional; many strong enemies do not permit the needed freeze / knockdown result. Use damage, oil and openings instead.
No held Quen healingMain has basic Quen only. Use the Shielded variant for Active Shield; Exploding Shield is a different effect.
Stamina is emptyDo not spend into another attack commitment. Successful evasion supports Sidestep only while it is active.
Six pieces but no bonusCheck all six are Forgotten Wolven Grandmaster pieces, including swords; Basic or ordinary Wolven pieces do not substitute.
Alternative mode / set multipliersExact stacking, per-target damage and Sweep / Piercing Cold / six-piece interactions are not measured here. No guaranteed multiplier is claimed.

Whirl Forgotten Wolf — sword-and-Sign spellblade

Trade Fortify Signs, Sidestep and Chain Reaction for Muscle Memory, Whirl and Razor Focus. Keep the Aard/Yrden damage tools, but give up some casting comfort.

Leveling skill point order — Whirl Forgotten Wolf, start fresh

Earned a point? Finish the first incomplete target. At 2/3, add one rank to reach 3/3. BANK reserves points while you continue below. Return rows buy only missing ranks; extra Place-of-Power points advance the same order.

Swipe left/right for actions. Targets are skill ranks, not character levels.

40 ordinary points: 36 active ranks + Three Strikes, Undying, Fleet-Footed and Focus at 1/3 inactive. Focus is needed on this fresh path to open Aftershock without Chain Reaction / Sidestep.

Use main blue mutation / extra-skill sequence →: 42 after Magic Sensibilities; 48 at Piercing Cold + Exploding Shield extra. Piercing Cold does not allow a red extra skill.

Final build — changes from main
RemoveEquipWhy
Fortify Signs 3/3Muscle Memory 3/3Sword follow-up after evasion instead of longer Sign durations.
Sidestep 3/3Whirl 3/3Sustained crowd punish instead of the casting discount.
Chain Reaction 3/3Razor Focus 3/3Adrenaline support instead of the alternating-Sign intensity benefit.

The other nine ordinary skills, equipment and blue mutation path match main.

Mutagens: blue for Far-Reaching Aard + Aard Sweep + Shockwave; blue for Sustained Glyphs + Magic Trap + Supercharged Glyphs; blue for Catalyst + Aftershock + Griffin Techniques (two matches); red for Muscle Memory + Whirl + Razor Focus.

Combat change: Yrden → useful Aard → safe Whirl opening → release and reset. Whirl spends resources; it can reduce available Adrenaline for Piercing Cold. Fleet-Footed and Undying are inactive on the fresh path, so they provide neither dodge protection nor revival.
